description: Mozambique - Floods - January 2026 - OpenStreetMap Data is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). This dataset contains OpenStreetMap data exported from the HOTOSM disaster mapping in response to flooding events in the Gaza, Maputo and Maputo City Provinces of Mozambique (GLIDE: FL-2026-000004-MOZ) in early 2026. Severe flooding in Mozambique has affected more than half a million people following heavy rains in the first weeks of the new year. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, flooding, geodata, natural disasters, roads. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
